name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
title: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd - 540078 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA margin hit 16.45% but management calls 10% sustainable; FY26 margin 9.90% on 5.4% revenue growth, with a 30% FY27 growth target that is a planning figure, not order-backed.

triggers.label: Q4 margin lift partly raw-material windfall
triggers.quote: some part, the extra margin has come up from maybe the war situation

triggers.label: FY27 growth ~30%, planning not order-backed
triggers.quote: it is never a more than order book for more than one month. So definitely it is a planning only

triggers.label: IBC entry, capacity and capex undisclosed
triggers.quote: We will be very early into this. So let us come up.

triggers.label: Revenue deliberately cut for margin
triggers.quote: we are compromising with our sales which are not profitable

guidance.quote: minimum, minimum 30% growth this year, minimum.
achieving INR1,000 crores in annual revenue by FY'28
We have already announced that Quarter 2 we will start.
